307.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
        WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 'Hydrogen'
        WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN a.element = 's' THEN 'Sulfur'
        WHEN a.element = 'n' THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN a.element = 'p' THEN 'Phosphorus'
        WHEN a.element = 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN a.element = 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
        WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN 'Iodine'
        WHEN a.element = 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN a.element = 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
        WHEN a.element = 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN a.element = 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
        ELSE a.element
    END AS element_name
FROM connected c
INNER JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

944.sql:
WITH c_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
c_results_pos AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.time, r.position
    FROM c_race cr
    JOIN results r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
),
c_champion AS (
    SELECT driverId, time
    FROM c_results_pos
    WHERE position = 1
),
c_last AS (
    SELECT driverId, time
    FROM c_results_pos
    WHERE position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM c_results_pos)
)
SELECT 
  ( ( 
    (CAST(STRFTIME('%H', c_champion.time) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
     CAST(STRFTIME('%M', c_champion.time) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
     CAST(STRFTIME('%S', c_champion.time) AS INTEGER) + 
     (CAST(SUBSTR(c_champion.time, -6) AS REAL) / 1000)) 
    - 
    CAST(c_last.time AS REAL)
  ) / CAST(c_last.time AS REAL) ) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM c_champion, c_last;
